concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-local-payment-methods-trustly]] - collected Trustly route for direct bank-account initiation, method-specific `EUR`/`DKK`/`GBP`/`NOK`/`SEK` applicability, non-instant post-settlement transaction association, server-side GraphQL, required success/expiry webhooks and sandbox-only timing, preserving unresolved family-guide conflicts over blanket euro presentment and customer-confirmation funding
warnings: The same-date family guide says Local Payment Method transactions are presented in euros and funds settle once the customer confirms payment, while the Trustly guide maps EUR, DKK, GBP, NOK and SEK by buyer country and says Trustly is non-instant with transaction association only after settlement confirmation; preserve this as unresolved and do not equate customer approval or confirmation, Payment Context state, webhook delivery, settlement and funding.
